tasks.title: Dual-runtime coordination guard
tasks.detail: load_duckdb compares a standalone libduckdb duckdb_library_version() vs the wheel version and refuses on mismatch (or when unreadable); libraries_coordinated() + extract_connection_ptr refuse an uncoordinated runtime.
tasks.commit: 97787a9 (+ d9558dd: also refuse an unreadable standalone version)

tasks.title: Fail-closed SHA-256 download integrity — REMOVED as security theater
tasks.detail: Ported in 35c0360 + pin dict expanded in 120706e, then REMOVED wholesale in d9558dd on user direction. The pins were digests we computed from the same GitHub release zips they vouched for = trust-on-first-use, no root of trust (DuckDB ships no signed checksum). Same trust pip already extends to the duckdb wheel; the pin bought no real defense while fail-closing macOS users on every new duckdb release until a human added a pin. Removed the pin table, NUMBDUCK_LIBDUCKDB_SHA256 override, _expected_zip_sha256, _verify_cached_dylib, sidecar, _sha256_file, and the fail-closed refusal, plus their tests. KEPT (genuine, not theater): bounded urlopen timeout, post-download C-API symbol re-check, atomic os.replace cache write via unique temp file, EOF/non-TTY-safe consent.

tasks.title: Loader refactor for testability
tasks.detail: Split _download_libduckdb into _consent_to_download + _fetch_and_cache(url,dest) drivable via file://; EOF/non-TTY-safe consent; side-effect-free locator; end-anchored regexes; explicit legacy-cache migration. (Simplified when T9 pinning was removed: _fetch_and_cache no longer takes/verifies a digest.)
